titulo: This Custom Xbox-Inside-An-Alligator Console Is Actually One Big Ad For GTA 6
texto: Given that Sony holds the marketing rights for Grand Theft Auto 6 , Microsoft has had to get creative to promote the open-world crime game for Xbox--and the company's latest effort in that department goes big. Say Hello to the X-Bite, a playable Xbox Series X console that was designed to look like it was swallowed whole by one of Florida's millions of alligators. Microsoft only made one of these ornate consoles, and you have to win a contest to get it. Microsoft's blog post doesn't mention GTA 6 or Rockstar Games, but Xbox marketing boss Josh Munsee said the system has "pure Miami vibes," and that's a pretty obvious reference to GTA 6 given the game takes place in a stand-in, Vice City, for the popular Florida city. The blog post says the winner of the console can play "some of the biggest games of the year" using it, and that's no doubt another nod to GTA 6. https://www.youtube.com/watc

titulo: GTA 6 Is Getting A Physical Map–Here’s How To Get One For Free Or Very Cheap
texto: Rockstar Games has confirmed more details about Grand Theft Auto 6 's impending release on November 19, including more information about physical goodies. While the game itself won't be available on a disc, Rockstar is offering a printable physical GTA 6 cover art poster and a map of the game's setting, Leonida. The poster and Leonida map will be available for free as digital downloads on GTA 6's official website on November 19. A double-sized physical version of the poster will be available "shortly after launch" from the Rockstar Store for 99 cents. Alternatively, it's free with any purchase from the Rockstar Store . https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wmKu9Uow-os Back in the day, Rockstar used to include fold-out posters in the box for GTA games featuring the game's cover art and map. titulo: GTA 6 File Size Revealed, And It’s Truly Massive–See How It Compares To Other Huge Games
texto: Ahead of the game's release on November 19, GTA 6' s file size has been revealed, and it is massive. Rockstar Games has confirmed that people will need about 212GB of space to install the game. As announced previously, preloading for GTA 6 begins on November 10, which is good news considering the game is massive in terms of its file size. People will no doubt have to delete other content to fit the game on the PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. This is double the file size of Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption II. How does GTA 6 file size compare to other games? Content creator NikTek put together a graphic that shows how GTA 6's file size, 212GB, compares to other big games--and it's the biggest. As you can see, the next closest is Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War (175GB), followed by Assassin's Creed Valhalla (160GB), Stalker 2 (160GB), and Forza Horizon 6 (156GB). https://twitter.com/NikT
